text:
We examine the techniques the game designers utilize to incite player curiosity, how the writings of a lost civilization provide the player with clues about where to go and what to do next, and what this all looks like when it comes together in one of the game’s most exciting discoveries.

From the team behind @LessonsfromtheScreenplay.
